pr.body:
## Summary

补齐 Sprint 7 四项已执行工作的可核对载体：#745 Editor 投影、#746 Harness follow-tail、#1147 冻结历史决定，以及 #754 Dialog 检查有效性实验。修复有界派生索引和历史执行项归属，并保留真实失败、原始分母及未测试环境。

当前 PR 是整合载体；它不表示 Sprint 7 其余消费/对照实验或发布接受已完成。

## Related context

- Issues: #745, #746, #1147, #754; historical index references #513 / #514; remaining early-entry regression owner #1178.
- Authorities: existing consumer portfolio / editor projection records, original 1,697-object history source bank, P-BASE-DIALOG-CONTENT / P-BASE-DIALOG-CLOSE and T-BASE-DIALOG-CONTENT-0001.
- Lifecycle: existing draft criteria remain draft. No public component or lifecycle promotion.

## Changes and evidence

1. Bind follow-tail to the actual merged Shenko consumer and exact package / deployment evidence (82/82 + eight Tab observations at their original revisions). Retain editor Option C as a proposal, engine as infrastructure-exempt and historical deferred M0 scope.
2. Add explicit producer refresh of only the three reconciled consumer issue-index rows. A stale-index negative control failed before the repair; unknown row IDs fail closed.
3. Independently accept all 1,697 frozen historical decisions against retained sources: preserve 9,442 current checkboxes and 2,520 original conditions, review all 496 candidate routes and correct 219 object projections. Historical acceptance is separate from implementation completion.
4. Execute actual Dialog discrimination against real WC/Base Dialog modules: nine cells, 297 assertions (274 pass and 23 intentional mutant failures). The original 28 checks catch five component defects; the held-out application Cancel→Save defect is missed by those checks and observed by the added action criterion. Two legal customizations produce no false alarms.
5. Keep original unmodified Dialog early-entry failures, a rejected cancelability hypothesis, all raw runs and exact source/preparation hashes. The settled-entry experiment does not claim the unmodified ordinary suite passed.

Records:
- internal/records/2026-11-24-sprint7-harness-projection-acceptance.md
- internal/records/2026-11-24-sprint-7-history-independent-acceptance.md
- internal/records/2026-11-24-dialog-conformance-discrimination.md

## Validation

- Focused editor projection checks: 5/5.
- Targeted producer controls, portfolio generation/check, documentation checks and agent-operation validators: successful source-bound receipts.
- Four history governance modules: 29/29; full independent historical source comparison passes.
- Dialog classifier/preparation controls: 13/13; final nine-cell collection contains 23 expected mutant assertion failures, not a falsely all-green suite.
- Integrated focused Dialog + history checks: 24/24.
- Retained non-passes: complete coverage-matrix process SIGKILL; combined prototype aggregate test-file failure without individual assertions. Prior editor/matrix 129/129 remains bound to its original source, not this candidate.
- Frozen Dialog fixture has an extra EOF blank line, yielding a nonsemantic diff-check warning. Frozen experiment input is retained byte-for-byte.
- Trusted repository CI, native DCO and exact-head platform-independent approval remain pending.

## Scope boundary

No product Dialog implementation or existing repository regression test was changed. No new public Prototype identity, website behavior, cross-host extraction, physical input, screen-reader, full-family or release acceptance is claimed. The early-entry finding is retained for #1178; current experimental findings do not fabricate a product fix.

No unresolved product direction is introduced by this patch. Repository integration conditions remain applicable.

## Source and contribution provenance

This is Agent-authored work performed for the current user's explicit Sprint 7 completion request. Codex generated the implementation/evidence processing and records; fresh Agent contexts performed bounded independent source acceptance and experiment work. Git commits use the actual Codex author/committer and Codex sign-off; no human DCO or GitHub approval is impersonated.

Existing Proto UI sources, public repository history, Shenko's existing accepted consumer evidence, and primary WAI-ARIA guidance are identified in the records. No private bot content, credentials or participant personal data are included. Native DCO is a separate live check.

## Agent evidence

Request paraphrase: complete the original remaining Sprint 7 criteria without discarding valid earlier work or hiding failed/unrun evidence.

Baseline: d0eb81d3c61c3d3e93e46c4151e78031273d6116. Initial carrier head: 49d8102da5421cade92de85afec6aa68d46ec85c. Procedure, times, source hashes, raw artifacts, observations and limitations are in the three records and evidence directories. This change primarily concerns source/evidence projections and a synthetic WC experiment; it does not claim new production visual acceptance.

Publication debt: PR/index links will be read back and added to affected Issues after exact-head review and integration. Verification debt: the two broader local non-passes and ordinary Dialog early-entry failure remain explicit. Other-host/AT/model experiments are outside #754's declared settled-entry observation; they are not silently accepted.

## Review readiness

Draft pending live CI/DCO, independent exact-head review and integration. No self-approval is requested. This PR does not auto-close Issues before their bounded acceptance and actual integration receipts are reconciled.
